note: Representative model-visible error shapes for the pinned `edit` tool (default hashline mode) at commit 08819b279cf02ae2545e69dad7111ab48d91d35e. `template` is verbatim from the cited upstream source; `example` renders the template with representative values. Hashline mismatch shapes come from packages/hashline/src/mismatch.ts; multi-entry shapes from packages/coding-agent/src/edit/index.ts.

entries.template:
Edit rejected for ${path}: file changed between read and edit.
Section is bound to #${expectedFileHash}, but the current file hashes to #${actualFileHash}. If a prior edit in this session modified this file, copy the [path#newhash] header from that edit's response; otherwise re-read the file with `read` to refresh the tag before retrying.
entries.example:
Edit rejected for src/foo.ts: file changed between read and edit.
Section is bound to #1A2B, but the current file hashes to #3C4D. If a prior edit in this session modified this file, copy the [foo.ts#3C4D] header from that edit's response; otherwise re-read the file with `read` to refresh the tag before retrying.

entries.template:
Edit rejected for ${path}: hash #${expectedFileHash} is not from this session.
The current file hashes to #${actualFileHash}. Re-read the file with `read` to copy a current [path#tag] header — never invent the tag and never reuse one from a prior session.
entries.example:
Edit rejected for src/foo.ts: hash #9F00 is not from this session.
The current file hashes to #3C4D. Re-read the file with `read` to copy a current [foo.ts#3C4D] header — never invent the tag and never reuse one from a prior session.

entries.template: Invalid line reference. Expected a bare line number from read/search output plus the section header content-hash tag (for example [src/foo.ts#XXXX] and line "160")${received}
entries.example: Invalid line reference. Expected a bare line number from read/search output plus the section header content-hash tag (for example [src/foo.ts#1A2B] and line "160") Received "abc".

entries.template: Line ${line} does not exist (file has ${lineCount} lines)
entries.example: Line 500 does not exist (file has 42 lines)

entries.template: line ${patchLine}: Invalid absolute range: start ${start}, end ${end}. The value after `.=` is an absolute source line, not a line count or replacement length. For one line use `${single}`.
entries.example: line 3: Invalid absolute range: start 10, end 15. The value after `.=` is an absolute source line, not a line count or replacement length. For one line use `PUT 10:`.
Error editing src/foo.ts: Line 500 does not exist (file has 42 lines)

entries.template: Files NOT applied: ${skippedPaths}; re-read the affected files and re-issue only the failed and unapplied files.
entries.example: Files NOT applied: src/a.ts, src/b.ts; re-read the affected files and re-issue only the failed and unapplied files.

entries.template: Auto-prefixed bare body row(s) with `+`. Body rows must be `+TEXT` literal lines.
entries.example: Auto-prefixed bare body row(s) with `+`. Body rows must be `+TEXT` literal lines.
